verdict.rationale: The public SOS corporations page links a 'Filings, Forms & Information (Download Forms)' section, so the forms can be downloaded with no login implied. The related DOR business-license page also lets founders expand 'By Mail' to download and complete all listed forms instead of using the online account system. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that no account is required, evidence that filing instructions are downloadable alongside the forms, and independent or hands-on verification of the downloads.
